attacks.name: Psionic Vampirism
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
After this attack is resolved, this character removes 1 |!damage| from itself.
|!wild| |*Sap Power|: Before |!damage| is dealt, the defender loses 1 |!power| for each |!wild| in the attack roll, and this character gains that amount of |!power|.

attacks.name: Psionic Concussion
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |*Pull|: After this attack is resolved, if |!damage| was dealt and the defender is |!size| 4 or less, this character may Push it Toward this character |!movement_small|.

attacks.name: You Can Do Nothing but Fall
steps: After each attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition.

superPowers.name: My Faith Can Move Mountains
superPowers.body: This character may spend up to 4 |!power| to use this superpower. Choose an interactive terrain feature within |!range| 3 with a Size equal to or less than the |!power| spent on this superpower. Throw the chosen terrain feature |!movement_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Teleportation
superPowers.body: Place this character within |!range| 2 of its current position. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Telekinetic Shield
superPowers.body: When this character or an allied character within |!range| 3 of this character is targeted by an attack, this character may use this superpower. Add 2 dice to the defender's defense roll against this attack. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Psionic of the Highest Order
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 additional |!power|.

erratas.body: Stamina increased from 7 to 8 on Healthy side.
The timing for Psionic Concussion's Pull special rule was clarified from "After |!damage| is dealt" to "After this attack is resolved".
The French version of the card has a typo on Psionic Concussion's Pull special rule. It overlooks the optional nature of the Push Toward.
